claim.claim-text: 1. A fluid control valve for controlling fluid flow the valve comprising:
2. The fluid control valve of claim 1, wherein the restraining element (425) is configured to degrade in response to temperature change, hydrolysis, dissolution, and oxidation.
3. The fluid control valve of claim 1, wherein the restraining element (425) is configured to degrade in response to a fluid in fluid communication with the restraining element (425).
4. The fluid control valve of claim 1, wherein the restraining element (425) is configured to degrade over a period of time.
5. The fluid control valve of claim 1, where the restraining element (425) is located in the first space and is isolated from the second space.
6. The fluid control valve of claim 1, where the restraining element (425) is located in the second space and is isolated from the first space.
7. The fluid control valve of claim 1, where the restraining element (425) is located outside of the fluid path (450).
8. The fluid control valve of claim 1, where the restraining element (425) forms a portion of the fluid path (450).
9. The fluid control valve of claim 1, where the restraining element (425) is located within the fluid path (450).

10. The fluid control valve of claim 1, where the traveler structure (412) comprises a binary configuration when in an open configuration or in a closed configuration, such that the fluid control valve comprises a binary fluid control valve.
11. The fluid control valve of claim 1, wherein the traveler structure (412) and the restraining element (425) comprise a single part.

12. The fluid control valve of claim 1, wherein the traveler structure (412) separates from the restraining element (425) upon degrading to release the energy storage device (420) from the stored energy condition.
13. The fluid control valve of claim 1, wherein the energy storage device (420) is a spring.
14. The fluid control valve of claim 1, wherein the traveler structure (412) and the base (414) comprise a single closed-ended tube in the closed configuration.
15. The fluid control valve of claim 1, wherein the restraining element (425) is configured to reduce in a mechanical integrity over a pre-determined period when exposed to environmental conditions.
